changelog: v0.0.2: Integrated full Unified Tweaks suite alongside SF Cheat Menu asset patches into 25 independently toggleable categories.

Enable_NoIntroVideo.label: Master Switch: Skip Intro Video
Enable_NoIntroVideo.description: Skips the startup logo videos and fade-in delays (Default: false)

Enable_Category_LevelsSkills.label: Master Switch: Levels & Skill Tree
Enable_Category_LevelsSkills.description: Enables or disables all player/item level caps, skill points per level, and zero-cost skill tree perks in this category.

Enable_PlayerItemLevelTweaks.label: Player / Item Level Cap Tweaks
Enable_PlayerItemLevelTweaks.description: Applies custom Player XP Cap, Item Level Cap, and Skill Points Per Level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelCapSync.label: Sync Item Level Cap
Enable_ItemLevelCapSync.description: Syncs global item cap with individual item cap limits (Default: false)

PlayerLevelCap.label: Player XP Cap Level
PlayerLevelCap.description: Level at which the player stops earning XP (Default: 50)

SkillPointsPerLevel.label: Skill Points Per Level
SkillPointsPerLevel.description: Amount of skill points acquired per level up (Default: 2)

freeSkillTree.label: Free Skill Tree Node Perks (0 SP Cost)
freeSkillTree.description: Sets skill point costs of all skill tree nodes to 0 so every perk can be learned freely.

Enable_AttributeScaling.label: Master Switch: Attribute Scaling
Enable_AttributeScaling.description: Enables or disables per-attribute stat scaling changes in this category (Default: false)

Enable_Category_BaseStats.label: Master Switch: Player Base Stats & Comfort
Enable_Category_BaseStats.description: Enables or disables base player stats (Health, Mana, Stamina, Oxygen, Shroud Time) and Comfort rested buff multipliers.

Enable_PlayerBaseStats.label: Override Player Base Stats
Enable_PlayerBaseStats.description: Applies custom base Health, Mana, Stamina, Oxygen, and Shroud timer values (Default: false)

PlayerFog_PerFlameLevel.label: Shroud Time per Flame Level (s)
PlayerFog_PerFlameLevel.description: Extra shroud time per flame level in seconds (Default: 60)

comfortBuffMultiplier.label: Comfort Rested Buff Multiplier
comfortBuffMultiplier.description: Scales rested buff duration from shelter comfort (1x = vanilla, up to 100x).

Enable_ItemLevelMinimums.label: Master Switch: Item Level Minimums
Enable_ItemLevelMinimums.description: Forces dropped items to a minimum level per item type (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Weapon.label: Min Level: Weapon
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Weapon.description: Force dropped weapons to a minimum level. Suggest 5 levels under max for in-game upgrades (Default: false)

ItemLevelMin_Weapon.label: Weapon Min Level
ItemLevelMin_Weapon.description: Min level for dropped weapons (Default: varies)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Armor.label: Min Level: Armor
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Armor.description: Force dropped armor to a minimum level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Shield.label: Min Level: Shield
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Shield.description: Force dropped shields to a minimum level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Gem.label: Min Level: Gem
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Gem.description: Force dropped gems to a minimum level (Default: false)

ItemLevelMin_Gem.label: Gem Min Level
ItemLevelMin_Gem.description: Min level for dropped gems (Default: varies)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Ring.label: Min Level: Ring
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Ring.description: Force dropped rings to a minimum level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Spell.label: Min Level: Spell
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Spell.description: Force dropped spells to a minimum level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Arrow.label: Min Level: Arrow
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Arrow.description: Force dropped arrows to a minimum level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Tool.label: Min Level: Tool
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Tool.description: Force dropped tools to a minimum level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Misc.label: Min Level: Misc
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Misc.description: Force other leveled items to a minimum level (Default: false)

ItemLevelMin_Misc.label: Misc Min Level
ItemLevelMin_Misc.description: Min level for miscellaneous items (Default: varies)

Enable_DamageTweaks.label: Master Switch: Weapon & Spell Damage
Enable_DamageTweaks.description: Enables or disables static item damage multipliers and bow draw speed scaling (Default: false)

BowDrawSpeed_Multiplier.label: Bow Draw Speed Multiplier
BowDrawSpeed_Multiplier.description: Multiplies bow draw / charge time, lower is faster (Default: 1.0, e.g. 0.5 = 2x faster draw)

Enable_ToolTweaks.label: Master Switch: Harvesting Tool Damage
Enable_ToolTweaks.description: Enables or disables Felling Axe and Pickaxe harvesting damage multipliers (Default: false)

ToolMult_Axe.label: Axe Wood Damage Multiplier
ToolMult_Axe.description: Multiplies Wood damage specifically for Felling Axes (Default: 1.0)

ToolMult_Pickaxe.label: Pickaxe Stone/Terrain Multiplier
ToolMult_Pickaxe.description: Multiplies Stone/Terrain damage specifically for Pickaxes (Default: 1.0)

Enable_GearStatTweaks.label: Master Switch: Gear Stats & Regen
Enable_GearStatTweaks.description: Enables or disables Health/Mana/Stamina bonus and regen multipliers on Armor and Rings (Default: false)

RegenMult_Health.label: Gear Health Regen Multiplier
RegenMult_Health.description: Multiplies health regeneration rate from gear (Default: 1.0)

RegenMult_Mana.label: Gear Mana Regen Multiplier
RegenMult_Mana.description: Multiplies mana regeneration rate from gear (Default: 1.0)

RegenMult_Stamina.label: Gear Stamina Regen Multiplier
RegenMult_Stamina.description: Multiplies stamina regeneration rate from gear (Default: 1.0)

GearMult_HealthBonus.label: Gear Health Bonus Multiplier
GearMult_HealthBonus.description: Multiplier for flat health bonuses on gear (Default: 1.0)

GearMult_StaminaBonus.label: Gear Stamina Bonus Multiplier
GearMult_StaminaBonus.description: Multiplier for flat stamina bonuses on gear (Default: 1.0)

GearMult_ManaBonus.label: Gear Mana Bonus Multiplier
GearMult_ManaBonus.description: Multiplier for flat mana bonuses on gear (Default: 1.0)

Enable_SpellTweaks.label: Master Switch: Spell Casting & Mana Cost
Enable_SpellTweaks.description: Enables or disables spell cast time and mana cost multipliers (Default: false)

SpellCastTime_Multiplier.label: Spell Cast Time Multiplier
SpellCastTime_Multiplier.description: Multiplies spell cast time, lower is faster (Default: 1.0, e.g. 0.2 = 5x faster)

SpellManaCost_Multiplier.label: Spell Mana Cost Multiplier
SpellManaCost_Multiplier.description: Multiplies spell mana cost, lower is cheaper (Default: 1.0, e.g. 0.0 = free)

Enable_Category_Storage.label: Master Switch: Backpack & Chest Storage
Enable_Category_Storage.description: Enables or disables Backpack slot expansion, Chest slot capacity, and Extended Magic Storage.

Enable_BackpackTweaks.label: Backpack Slot Multiplier Tweak
Enable_BackpackTweaks.description: Overrides backpack slot sizes. Unequip your backpack before enabling or changing backpack settings! (Default: false)

Backpack_SlotMultiplier.label: Backpack Slot Multiplier
Backpack_SlotMultiplier.description: Multiplies slots for each backpack up to a safe cap of 40 (Default: 1)

Chest_SlotMultiplier.label: Chest Slot Multiplier
Chest_SlotMultiplier.description: Multiplies each storage chest tier's base capacity up to Chest Max Slots (Default: 2)

Enable_MagicFurniture.label: Extended Magic Storage: Furniture
Enable_MagicFurniture.description: Enables pull-from-storage magic crafting stock on decorative furniture with inventory slots (Default: false)

Enable_MagicFactories.label: Extended Magic Storage: Factories
Enable_MagicFactories.description: Enables pull-from-storage magic crafting stock on production buildings with Quick-Stack deposit disabled (Default: false)

Enable_StackSizeTweaks.label: Master Switch: Item Stack Sizes
Enable_StackSizeTweaks.description: Enables or disables overriding maximum item stack sizes on safe stackable items (Default: true)

StackSize_MaxStack.label: Max Stack Size
StackSize_MaxStack.description: Maximum stack size across safe stackable items up to 65,535 (never lowers items with larger native stacks)

Enable_LootTweaks.label: Master Switch: Loot Drop Multipliers
Enable_LootTweaks.description: Enables or disables granular category loot drop multipliers across world pickups, chests, and enemies (Default: false)

Loot_WorldDropMultiplier.label: Non-Scalable World Loot Multiplier
Loot_WorldDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for world loot drops not scaled by the difficulty slider (berries, honey, herbs, mushrooms) (Default: 1.0)

Loot_ScalableDropMultiplier.label: Scalable World Loot Multiplier
Loot_ScalableDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for scalable world loot drops (wood, stone, ores, plant fiber, resin, metal scraps) (Default: 1.0)

Loot_EnemyDropMultiplier.label: Enemy & Wildlife Loot Multiplier
Loot_EnemyDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for NPC, Enemy, and Wildlife drops (runes, shroud cores, raw meat, fur, bones) (Default: 1.0)

Loot_EquipmentDropMultiplier.label: Equipment Loot Multiplier
Loot_EquipmentDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for non-scalable weapons, armor, shields, and rings inside chests/containers (Default: 1.0)

Loot_ConsumableDropMultiplier.label: Consumable Loot Multiplier
Loot_ConsumableDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for potions, bandages, scrolls, flasks, and cooked/processed foods (Default: 1.0)

Loot_ExplosiveDropMultiplier.label: Explosive Loot Multiplier
Loot_ExplosiveDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for thrown grenades and explosive powder balls (Default: 1.0)

Loot_ArrowDropMultiplier.label: Arrow Loot Multiplier
Loot_ArrowDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for stackable player arrows and ammunition (Default: 1.0)

Loot_CollectibleDropMultiplier.label: Collectibles Loot Multiplier
Loot_CollectibleDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for world collectibles, fossils, dyes, and music sheets (Default: 1.0)

Loot_GoldDropMultiplier.label: Gold & Coins Loot Multiplier
Loot_GoldDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for Gold Coins across enemies, chests, and coin veins (Default: 1.0)

Enable_GemTweaks.label: Master Switch: Gem Salvage & Slots
Enable_GemTweaks.description: Enables or disables gem salvage return rate and gem slot rarity probability tweaks (Default: false)

GemTweaks_SalvageRate.label: Gem Salvage Rate (0.0 - 1.0)
GemTweaks_SalvageRate.description: Ratio of material returned when salvaging gems, clamped 0.0 to 1.0 (Default: 0.5)

GemTweaks_Probability_Common.label: Gem Slot Prob (Common)
GemTweaks_Probability_Common.description: Probability (0.0 - 1.0) of a gem slot on common rarity items (Default: 0.0)

GemTweaks_Probability_Uncommon.label: Gem Slot Prob (Uncommon)
GemTweaks_Probability_Uncommon.description: Probability (0.0 - 1.0) of a gem slot on uncommon rarity items (Default: 0.05)

GemTweaks_Probability_Rare.label: Gem Slot Prob (Rare)
GemTweaks_Probability_Rare.description: Probability (0.0 - 1.0) of a gem slot on rare rarity items (Default: 0.25)

GemTweaks_Probability_Epic.label: Gem Slot Prob (Epic)
GemTweaks_Probability_Epic.description: Probability (0.0 - 1.0) of a gem slot on epic rarity items (Default: 0.5)

GemTweaks_Probability_Legendary.label: Gem Slot Prob (Legendary)
GemTweaks_Probability_Legendary.description: Probability (0.0 - 1.0) of a gem slot on legendary rarity items (Default: 1.0)

Enable_CraftingTweaks.label: Master Switch: Crafting & Recipes
Enable_CraftingTweaks.description: Enables or disables Creative Mode free crafting, infinite prop placement, recipe unlocks, free upgrades, and output multipliers.

CraftingTweaks_CreativeMode.label: Creative Mode (Free Crafting & No NPC Shelter Req)
CraftingTweaks_CreativeMode.description: Removes crafting material costs and NPC shelter/bed/station requirements on general recipes (Default: false)

CraftingTweaks_InfinitePropPlacement.label: Infinite Prop & Furniture Placement (No Item Consumed)
CraftingTweaks_InfinitePropPlacement.description: Prevents placed chests, furniture, workbenches, altars, and props from being consumed out of your inventory when placed.

CraftingTweaks_UnlockAllRecipes.label: Unlock All Recipes
CraftingTweaks_UnlockAllRecipes.description: Unlocks all crafting recipes and building blocks without requiring item discovery (Default: false)

CraftingTweaks_FreeFlameAltar.label: Free Flame Strengthening & Altar Upgrades
CraftingTweaks_FreeFlameAltar.description: Makes Flame strengthening and Flame Altar tier upgrades completely free (Default: true)

CraftingTweaks_FreeFood.label: Free Food Crafting
CraftingTweaks_FreeFood.description: Makes food and fish recipes free, independent of Creative Mode (Default: false)

CraftingTweaks_FreeFactories.label: Free Factories
CraftingTweaks_FreeFactories.description: Makes factory/refining station recipes free, independent of Creative Mode (Default: false)

CraftingTweaks_OutputMultiplier.label: Crafting Output Multiplier
CraftingTweaks_OutputMultiplier.description: Increases crafted quantity yield on stackable outputs, e.g. 2 = double output (Default: 1)

Enable_SlotResetTool.label: Master Switch: Factory & Station Crusher
Enable_SlotResetTool.description: Allows 1-hit destruction of selected factories/furniture even when items are inside (Default: false)

Reset_Factory.label: Crush: Factories (Forge, Smelter, Kiln, Oven, Loom, Saw)
Reset_Factory.description: Allows Factories to be 1-hit breakable even when full (Default: false)

Reset_Production.label: Crush: Production Stations
Reset_Production.description: Allows Production stations to be breakable (Default: false)

Reset_Farmbed.label: Crush: Farmbeds & Seedling Stations
Reset_Farmbed.description: Allows Garden and Seedling beds to be breakable (Default: false)

Reset_Beehive.label: Crush: Beehives & Honey Stations
Reset_Beehive.description: Allows Beehives to be breakable (Default: false)

Reset_Furniture.label: Crush: Slotted Furniture
Reset_Furniture.description: Allows slotted Furniture and non-chest decorative props to be breakable (Default: false)

Enable_Category_Movement.label: Master Switch: Movement, Jump & Slope Climbing
Enable_Category_Movement.description: Enables or disables player template movement speed, jump height, and steep slope climbing tweaks.

movementSpeedMultiplier.label: Movement Speed % (Walking & Sprinting)
movementSpeedMultiplier.description: Patches player locomotion run & sprint speeds (100% = vanilla, up to 500%).

jumpHeightMultiplier.label: Jump Height Multiplier %
jumpHeightMultiplier.description: Multiplies vertical jump launch height in player template (100% = vanilla, up to 500%).

Enable_SlopeTweaks.label: Slope Climbing Tweaks
Enable_SlopeTweaks.description: Overrides slope climbing, sliding, and fall damage angles on player template (Default: true)

steepFloorAngle.label: Steep Floor Angle
steepFloorAngle.description: Angle at which terrain becomes difficult to walk up, max 89.0 (Default: 45.0)

slidingAngle.label: Sliding Angle
slidingAngle.description: Angle at which you start sliding off terrain, max 89.0 (Default: 55.0)

fallDamageAngle.label: Fall Damage Angle
fallDamageAngle.description: Angle at which fall damage calculation triggers when sliding, max 89.0 (Default: 65.0)

Enable_SkillTweaks_Updraft.label: Master Switch: Updraft Skill Tuning
Enable_SkillTweaks_Updraft.description: Enables or disables custom Updraft glider boost impulse, duration, and mana cost tweaks (Default: false)

Updraft_IgnoreManaCost.label: Ignore Updraft Mana Cost
Updraft_IgnoreManaCost.description: Disables Updraft mana cost completely (Default: false)

GroundRelative_Y.label: Ground Relative Y
GroundRelative_Y.description: Absolute Y/Upwards thrust, leave blank to keep default (Default: 22)

GroundRelative_X.label: Ground Relative X
GroundRelative_X.description: Absolute X direction thrust, leave blank to keep default

GroundRelative_Z.label: Ground Relative Z
GroundRelative_Z.description: Absolute Z/Forward thrust, leave blank to keep default

PlayerRelative_X.label: Player Relative X
PlayerRelative_X.description: Right/Left thrust relative to player yaw/roll, leave blank to keep default

PlayerRelative_Y.label: Player Relative Y
PlayerRelative_Y.description: Up/Down thrust relative to player pitch/yaw, leave blank to keep default

PlayerRelative_Z.label: Player Relative Z
PlayerRelative_Z.description: Forward/Backward thrust relative to player pitch/yaw, leave blank to keep default

Boost_Duration.label: Boost Duration (s)
Boost_Duration.description: Duration of the updraft boost in seconds, leave blank to keep default (Default: 2.25)

Updraft_ManaCost_Value.label: Updraft Mana Cost
Updraft_ManaCost_Value.description: Manually override Updraft mana cost value, leave blank to keep default

Enable_Category_Map.label: Master Switch: Map, Fast Travel & Fog of War
Enable_Category_Map.description: Enables or disables custom Fast Travel destination categories and Map Fog of War discovery radius.

Enable_FastTravelTweaks.label: Fast Travel Marker Tweaks
Enable_FastTravelTweaks.description: Adds fast travel teleportation to selected map marker categories (Default: true)

FastTravel_FlameMarkers.label: Fast Travel: Flame Sanctums & Shrines
FastTravel_FlameMarkers.description: Enable fast travel to Flame Sanctums and Shrines (Default: true)

FastTravel_DungeonMarkers.label: Fast Travel: Dungeons & Hollow Halls
FastTravel_DungeonMarkers.description: Enable fast travel to Dungeons, Elixir Wells, and Hollow Halls (Default: true)

FastTravel_LocationMarkers.label: Fast Travel: Locations, Towns & Mines
FastTravel_LocationMarkers.description: Enable fast travel to Towns, Mines, and Farms (Default: true)

FastTravel_None.label: Fast Travel: Quest Markers
FastTravel_None.description: Enable fast travel to discovered Quest markers (Default: false)

Enable_FogOfWarTweaks.label: Fog of War Discovery Range Tweak
Enable_FogOfWarTweaks.description: Overrides map Fog of War discovery radius (Default: false)

FogOfWar_Range.label: Fog of War Range
FogOfWar_Range.description: Fog of war clearing radius on the map (Default: 300)

Enable_Category_AltarsBase.label: Master Switch: Flame Altars & Base Size
Enable_Category_AltarsBase.description: Enables or disables Flame Altar capacity limits, unlimited altars, and 20m-chunk-snapped build zone size multipliers.

Enable_FlameAltarTweaks.label: Flame Altar Capacity Multiplier (Capped at 16)
Enable_FlameAltarTweaks.description: Scales buildable Flame Altars per flame level up to Unified Tweaks' cap of 16 (Default: false)

MaxFlameAltars_Multiplier.label: Flame Altar Multiplier
MaxFlameAltars_Multiplier.description: Multiplies buildable Flame Altars per flame level up to 16 (Default: 2)

unlimitedFlameAltars.label: Unlimited Flame Altars (255 Cap & No Slot Req)
unlimitedFlameAltars.description: Sets maximum active Flame Altars to 255 and removes altar slot requirements on Flame Altar items.

Enable_BaseSizeTweaks.label: Base Build-Zone Size Multiplier
Enable_BaseSizeTweaks.description: Scales Flame Altar build zone boundaries snapped safely to 20m voxel chunks (Default: false)

BaseSize_Multiplier.label: Base Size Multiplier
BaseSize_Multiplier.description: Multiplies X, Y, Z dimensions of Flame Altar build zones up to 3.0x, snapped to 20m voxel chunks (Default: 1.5)

Enable_Category_BuildingPlacement.label: Master Switch: Building & Placement Rules
Enable_Category_BuildingPlacement.description: Enables or disables world No-Build Zone removal and unrestricted building placement rules (Default: false)

Enable_BuildingTweaks.label: Remove World No-Build Zones
Enable_BuildingTweaks.description: Allows placing Flame Altars inside restricted 'No Build Zones' in the game world (Default: false)

Enable_PlacementTweaks.label: Placement Rule Tweaks
Enable_PlacementTweaks.description: Enables the custom placement rule sub-toggles below (Default: false)

PlacementTweaks_BuildInFog.label: Build in Shroud Fog
PlacementTweaks_BuildInFog.description: Allows building placement directly inside Shroud fog (Default: false)

PlacementTweaks_NoBuildZoneNeeded.label: No Build Zone Needed
PlacementTweaks_NoBuildZoneNeeded.description: Allows temporary placement of objects outside Flame Altar zones (objects outside Altar zones do not persist on reload) (Default: false)

PlacementTweaks_IgnoreEnemies.label: Place Near Enemies
PlacementTweaks_IgnoreEnemies.description: Allows placing Flame Altars and objects even when enemies are nearby (Default: false)

PlacementTweaks_IgnoreFreeSpace.label: Ignore Free Space & Surface Checks
PlacementTweaks_IgnoreFreeSpace.description: Removes 'Not enough free space', collider, water, and surface topology checks (Default: false)

PlacementTweaks_UnlockTiltAngles.label: Unlock Placement Tilt & Rotation Angles
PlacementTweaks_UnlockTiltAngles.description: Requires 'Ignore Free Space & Surface Checks' enabled. Unlocks 180° tilt and free X/Y/Z axis rotation (Default: false)

Enable_FogTweaks.label: Master Switch: Fog & Weather Visibility
Enable_FogTweaks.description: Enables or disables world distance fog, weather storm haze, and Blue/Red Shroud visibility multipliers (Default: false)

Fog_WorldHaze_Multiplier.label: World & Distance Fog Multiplier
Fog_WorldHaze_Multiplier.description: Multiplies standard distance fog and height fog. 1.0 = Vanilla, 0.35 = Clearer views, 0.0 = No distance fog

Fog_WeatherHaze_Multiplier.label: Weather Haze Multiplier (Rain / Snow / Blizzard)
Fog_WeatherHaze_Multiplier.description: Multiplies visual fog/haze during rain, snow, and blizzards. 1.0 = Vanilla, 0.1 = Clear storm visibility

Fog_BlueShroud_Multiplier.label: Blue Shroud Fog Multiplier (Dangerous Shroud)
Fog_BlueShroud_Multiplier.description: Multiplies Blue Shroud fog density, opacity, and boundary walls. 1.0 = Vanilla, 0.6 = 40% clearer

Fog_RedShroud_Multiplier.label: Red Shroud Fog Multiplier (Deadly Shroud)
Fog_RedShroud_Multiplier.description: Multiplies Red Shroud fog density, opacity, and boundary walls. 1.0 = Vanilla, 0.6 = 40% clearer

Enable_GliderTuning.label: Master Switch: Glider Physics
Enable_GliderTuning.description: Enables or disables per-tier (T1-T4) glider speed, air resistance, and turn rate tuning (Default: false)

Glider_T1_airResistanceVertical.label: T1 Vertical Resistance
Glider_T1_airResistanceVertical.description: Vertical resistance, higher = lose altitude slower (Default: 0.71)

Glider_T2_airResistanceVertical.label: T2 Vertical Resistance
Glider_T2_airResistanceVertical.description: Vertical resistance, higher = lose altitude slower (Default: 0.95)

Glider_T3_airResistanceVertical.label: T3 Vertical Resistance
Glider_T3_airResistanceVertical.description: Vertical resistance, higher = lose altitude slower (Default: 1.6)

Glider_T4_REWARD_airResistanceVertical.label: T4 Vertical Resistance
Glider_T4_REWARD_airResistanceVertical.description: Vertical resistance, higher = lose altitude slower (Default: 3.0)

Enable_Category_Terraforming.label: Master Switch: Terraforming & Voxel Drops
Enable_Category_Terraforming.description: Enables or disables breakable unbreakable terrain, rake anywhere, and voxel terrain drop rates (Default: false)

MakeUnbreakableBreakable.label: Make Unbreakable Terrain Breakable
MakeUnbreakableBreakable.description: Changes Unbreakable terrain materials to Hard so they can be mined/excavated (Default: false)

rakeAnywhere.label: Terraform Rake Everywhere (No Base Required)
rakeAnywhere.description: Clears build-zone and fog restrictions on rakes so you can level terrain anywhere.

Enable_TerrainDropTweaks.label: Terrain Drop Rate Tweaks
Enable_TerrainDropTweaks.description: Enables terrain item drop modification per mined voxel (Default: false)

TerrainDrop_ExchangeRate.label: Terrain Drop Rate (0.0 - 1.0)
TerrainDrop_ExchangeRate.description: 1.0 = Full 1:1 drop rate per voxel, clamped to max 1.0 (Default: 0.2)

Enable_ExpandedGameSettings.label: Master Switch: Expanded Difficulty Sliders
Enable_ExpandedGameSettings.description: Expands world difficulty UI slider steps and backend server min/max presets (Default: false)

EGS_Time.label: Time Duration Steps (Minutes)
EGS_Time.description: Comma-separated time values in minutes for day, night, and starving timers

Log_Level.label: Log Verbosity Level
Log_Level.description: Controls log detail level in ShroudForge logs: 0 = Mute, 1 = Summary Logs, 2 = Detailed Item Logs (Default: 1)

groups.description: Gem salvage return rate and gem socket probabilities by item rarity.

groups.label: Movement, Jump & Slope Climbing
groups.description: Player template run/sprint speed, jump height, and steep cliff/mountain slope climbing angles.
